_doc: Sandstone / ochre mesa massif pieces for steppe and badlands ranges: the same footprints and canvases as massif-granite (see its _doc and docs/art/MASSIF_ART.md), flat-topped mesas, buttes and layered cliffs instead of snowy peaks. generate-image-v2 with an accepted granite piece as the style image but without copying its palette (style_options color_palette false), so outline, shading and pixel size match the granite set while the colours come from the subject. Palette: lit pale ochre #e0b47a, mid #c98e5a, shade #8e5638, stripes #a8643e, outline dark brown #4a2a20. Layers: style, light, class-massif, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one huge desert sandstone massif seen from the south, as tall as it is wide: it fills almost the whole image, its top a little below the top edge, its foot along the bottom edge and its flanks reaching the left and right edges. A tall flat-topped mesa at the left and a lower flat-topped butte at the right joined by a stepped shoulder, sheer cliffs with horizontal rock layers, scree slopes and a ragged foot of a few boulders. Lit faces pale ochre #e0b47a, shaded faces warm brown #8e5638, thin red-brown stripes #a8643e, outline dark brown #4a2a20. No snow, no grey. One solid mass.
recipes.negative: snow, grey rock, pointed peaks, trees, cactus, river, path, building
